''See also: [[Ornheim Incarnation Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Ornheim]] [[Incarnation]] is a massive, [[stone]]-based entity standing between nine and ten feet tall. Constructed from fine white [[stone]] characterized by multicolored veins, the creature possesses a highly detailed appearance resembling an aged, weathered man. Unlike traditional Golems{{!}}golems from [[Ornheim]] that typically feature gemstone eyes, this being has unsettlingly human-looking eyes capable of expressing intense fury. Incarnation{{!}}The Incarnation exhibits significant physical power, capable of tossing individuals aside easily and standing as an equal to [[Tartarus]] in both strength and stature. Its abilities include the capacity to manifest spinning rocks that strike like shooting stars, as well as the ability to cause [[stone]] to grow around itself. In combat, it has been seen wielding a red-and-black [[sword]] and can sustain damage from being lashed by [[chains]], which [[chips]] away at its solid [[stone]] skin.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|This towering [[stone]] creature possesses the form of an older man. His pale skin is composed of fine white [[stone]] marked by multicolored, marble-like veins.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The entity displays mountainous strength. Additionally, he has the power to summon Golems{{!}}golems.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Ornheim]] [[Incarnation]] is a towering [[stone]] creature that takes the form of an older man. His body consists of fine white [[stone]] marked by pale skin and veins of every color, resembling multicolored marble. Possessing mountainous strength, the entity eventually departed from [[Valinhall]]. During his travels, he demonstrated his power by summoning Golems{{!}}golems.}}
